about.title: scholarships na ọrụ, dakọtara na ihe kpatara ya.
about.lede: Ewuru maka ndị ike gwụla ịpịgharị bọọdụ jeneriki. Tinye ihe ị mụrụ na ihe ị nwere ike ime - anyị na-edepụta oghere wee kwuo ihe mere ha ji dabara.
about.ideaTitle: Dakọtara kwesịrị ịdị ka nkenke okwu, ọ bụghị mkpofu njikọ.
about.ideaBody1: Ngwa ọchụchọ na bọọdụ ohere na-egosi olu. Ha adịkarịghị ama akara mmụta sayensị Kọmputa gị, ikike mmeghachi omume gị, ma ọ bụ na ị na-etinye akwụkwọ na Botswana - ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ na ha akọwaghị ihe dabara adaba.
about.ideaBody2: Opportunistic na-edobe profaịlụ dị ndụ ma na-agba akwụkwọ mmụta na ọrụ dabara na ya. Nsonaazụ ọ bụla na-ebu akara, isi iyi na ihe kpatara ị nwere ike iji n'ezie.
about.p1Body: Degree, nka, na obodo bụ isi iyi nke eziokwu. Egwuregwu na-ewughachi mgbe ị gbanwere ha.
about.p2Title: Ihe kpatara na kaadị ọ bụla
about.p2Body: Akara na-enweghị nkọwa bụ mkpọtụ. Anyị na-ede ihe kpatara ndepụta ji kwekọọ - n'asụsụ doro anya.
about.p3Body: Anyị na-achọpụta na ọkwa. Ị na-etinye akwụkwọ na ụlọ akwụkwọ gọọmentị ma ọ bụ saịtị ọrụ.
about.areItem1: Profaịlụ mara ọkwa mmụta na egwuregwu ọrụ
about.areItem2: Ndụmọdụ akwụkwọ egwuregwu pụrụ iche maka nka na ebumnuche gị
about.areItem3: Chekwa, chụọ, ma megharịa mgbe profaịlụ gị gbanwere
about.notItem1: Anyị anaghị enye scholarships ma ọ bụ were onye ọ bụla were
about.notItem2: Anyị anaghị ekwe nkwa nnabata ma ọ bụ ego
about.notItem3: Na-enyocha oge imecha mgbe niile na ndepụta gọọmentị
about.studioBody: Opportunistic™ bụ ngwaahịa Futurify Designs - emebere ka ọ nwee mmetụta nke ziri ezi, dị jụụ ma baa uru, ọ bụghị dị ka bọọdụ ndebiri ọzọ.
about.ctaTitle: Ị dịla njikere inyefe profaịlụ gị?
about.ctaBody: Mepụta akaụntụ, gosi nka site na akara ugo mmụta gị, wee mepee egwuregwu ndị nwere oke na ebumnuche.

privacy.lede: Ntọala nchekwa data zuru ụwa ọnụ, njikwa kuki na-arụ ọrụ, yana ikike doro anya - emelitere maka Opportunistic.
privacy.langNote: Egosiri iwu a n'uju n'asụsụ ị họọrọ.

terms.title: Usoro ojiji
terms.lede: Iwu maka iji Opportunistic dị ka oyi akwa nchọpụta - ọ bụghị dị ka onye na-enye ohere ọ bụla.

privacyBody.overview: Opportunistic ("anyị") na-enye ohere agụmakwụkwọ na mmekọ ọrụ. Iwu a na-akọwa ihe anyị na-anakọta, ihe kpatara ya, ogologo oge anyị na-edebe ya, yana ikike gị. Anyị na-etinye usoro ntọala ọkwa GDPR maka onye ọrụ ọ bụla n'ụwa niile, anyị na-asọpụrụ iwu obodo siri ike ebe ha na-etinye (gụnyere UK GDPR, POPIA na South Africa, na usoro ndị yiri ya). Nke a bụ ntuziaka nnabata bara uru maka ngwaahịa anyị - ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ gbasara iwu maka ikike gị.
privacyBody.lawfulContractDesc: Ịmepụta akaụntụ gị, dakọtara na ịnye ọrụ ị rịọrọ
privacyBody.lawfulConsentDesc: Kuki nhọrọ (nyocha/ịzụ ahịa), email na-agbari gị ịbanye
privacyBody.lawfulLegitimateDesc: Nchekwa, mgbochi mmegbu, ntụkwasị obi ọrụ - kwadoro megide ikike gị
privacyBody.lawfulLegalDesc: Ebe anyị ga-ejigide ma ọ bụ kpughee data n'okpuru iwu ọdabara
privacyBody.storeAccountDesc: Email na nzere nzere site na Supabase Auth
privacyBody.storeProfileDesc: Aha, obodo, isi akụkọ, bio, ntozu, na nka ị tinyere
privacyBody.storeMatchesDesc: Aha, URL, isi mmalite, ntụgharị uche, akara, wee chekwaa/wepụ steeti
privacyBody.storeTechnicalDesc: Kuki nkwenye, kuki oge achọrọ maka nbanye, nyocha nhọrọ ma ọ bụrụ na ị kwere ha
privacyBody.cookiesIntro: Anyị na-eji kuki nkwenye (opp_consent) icheta nhọrọ gị ruo ọnwa iri na abụọ. Kuki ndị dị mkpa na-echekwa nyocha. Mmasị, nyocha, na kuki ịre ahịa na-ebu naanị mgbe ị banyere. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe obi gị oge ọ bụla.
privacyBody.cookiesNecessaryDesc: Oge nkwenye, nchekwa, na-echekwa nkwenye a
privacyBody.cookiesPreferencesDesc: Ebe nchekwa UI nhọrọ karịrị nkwenye
privacyBody.cookiesAnalyticsDesc: Nleta ojiji - akpọchiri scripts ruo mgbe ekwere ya
privacyBody.cookiesMarketingDesc: mkpado mgbasa ozi/reahịa — akpọchiri scripts ruo mgbe ekwere ya
privacyBody.cookiesOrFooter: - ma ọ bụ jiri ntọala kuki n'okpuru ụkwụ.
privacyBody.useBody: Profaịlụ gị na-eme ka ndụmọdụ dabara adaba. Anyị anaghị ere data nkeonwe. Anyị anaghị eji ntozu gị wuo profaịlụ mgbasa ozi ọ gwụla ma ị na-ekwe ka kuki ịre ahịa na ekpughere onye mgbasa ozi n'ọdịnihu ebe a.
privacyBody.transfersBody: Akụrụngwa nwere ike hazie data na mpaghara ndị na-eweta anyị na-eji (dịka ọmụmaatụ Supabase na Brevo). Ebe data hapụrụ obodo gị, anyị na-adabere na nchekwa kwesịrị ekwesị aghọtara n'okpuru iwu ụdị GDPR (dịka ụkpụrụ nkwekọrịta ọkọlọtọ nke ndị na-enye ndị ahụ na-enye) wee wedata ihe anyị na-echekwa.
privacyBody.retentionBody: Akaụntụ na data egwuregwu na-anọ mgbe akaụntụ gị na-arụ ọrụ. Ọ bụrụ na ihichapụ data gị na Ntọala, anyị na-ewepụ profaịlụ, ntozu, nka, egwuregwu na akụkọ ọchụchọ na nchekwa data ngwa. Enwere ike ịrịọ maka mkpochapụ akaụntụ na hello@opportunistic.online. Enwere ike idobe ndekọ nkwenye dị ka ihe akaebe nke nhọrọ ruo oge ndụ kuki ma ọ bụ dịka iwu chọrọ.
privacyBody.rightsBody: Dabere na ebe ị bi, ị nwere ike ịnwe ikike ịnweta, mezie, ihichapụ, machibido, ihe, data ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri, na iwepụ nkwenye. Anyị na-asọpụrụ ndị a dị ka ntọala zuru ụwa ọnụ. Ị nwere ike dezie profaịlụ gị oge ọ bụla wee hichapụ data gị na Ntọala.
privacyBody.rightsCalloutMid: → Hichapụ data m. Maka arịrịọ ndị ọzọ:
privacyBody.childrenBody: A naghị eduzi Opportunistic na ụmụaka na-erubeghị afọ 16 (ma ọ bụ afọ nkwenye dijitalụ dị elu na obodo gị). Emepụtala akaụntụ ma ọ bụrụ na ị nọ n'okpuru afọ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na anyị amụta na anyị na-ejide data dị otú ahụ, anyị ga-ehichapụ ya.
privacyBody.sharingBody: Anyị na ndị nhazi na-enye aka na-arụ ọrụ ahụ na-ekerịta data: Supabase (auth/database), Brevo (email azụmahịa mgbe enyere ya), na nnabata (GitHub Pages). Ndepụta mepere na saịtị ndị ọzọ nwere atumatu nke ha. Anyị anaghị ere data nkeonwe.
privacyBody.contactBody: Ajụjụ nzuzo ma ọ bụ arịrịọ ikike:

termsBody.roleBody: Opportunistic bụ ikpo okwu nchọta. Anyị na-ewepụta akwụkwọ mmụta ndị ọzọ na ndepụta ọrụ dabere na profaịlụ gị. Anyị abụghị onye na-enye, onye were ọrụ, ma ọ bụ onye na-enye ohere ọ bụla egosiri na saịtị ahụ.
termsBody.roleCallout: Mechaa ngwa mgbe niile na ndepụta isi mmalite gọọmentị. Opportunistic na-akọwa dabara; isi iyi nwere ntozu na nsonaazụ.
termsBody.accuracyBody: Ndepụta nwere ike ịbụ ihe ochie ka emechara ntụnye aha. Na-enyocha ntozu mgbe niile, ngwụcha ngwụcha, na usoro ngwa na webụsaịtị isi mmalite tupu itinye akwụkwọ. Ọnụọgụ dakọtara, ntụgharị uche, na ndụmọdụ bụ ndụmọdụ - ha abụghị nkwa nke nnabata, ego, ma ọ bụ ọrụ.
termsBody.accountAccuracyDesc: Ọ bụ gị na-ahụ maka izi ezi ozi ị nyefere
termsBody.accountOthersDesc: Ebulitela data nkeonwe onye ọzọ na-enweghị ikike
termsBody.accountFairDesc: Anyị nwere ike kwụsịtụ akaụntụ na-emetọ ma ọ bụ na-anwa ihichapụ ọrụ ahụ
termsBody.liabilityBody: Ruo n'ókè iwu kwadoro, Opportunistic agaghị akwụ ụgwọ maka mkpebi emere dabere na ndepụta ndị dị n'elu, gụnyere ohere mechiri emechi, ọdịnaya nke ndị ọzọ ezighi ezi, ma ọ bụ ngwa na-aga nke ọma.
termsBody.privacyAfter: na-akọwa ihe anyị na-anakọta yana ikike gị. Kuki nhọrọ na teknụzụ ndị yiri ya na-ebu naanị mgbe ị kwadoro site na ọkọlọtọ kuki ma ọ bụ ntọala kuki. Kuki ndị dị mkpa maka nchekwa, nbanye, na icheta nhọrọ ahụ ka dị. Lee
termsBody.changesBody: Anyị nwere ike imelite usoro ndị a ka ngwaahịa na-etolite. Ụbọchị emelitere n'elu ibe a na-egosipụta nlegharị anya kacha ọhụrụ. Ojiji gara n'ihu ka emechara mgbanwe pụtara ị nabata usoro edegharịrị.

reasons.primarySignal: Ejiri {{kind}} gị na {{field}}{{yearBit}}{{instBit}} mee ihe dị ka akara ngosi agụmakwụkwọ izizi.
reasons.focusField: Ogige elekwasị anya "{{field}}" eduzi ọkwa maka onyinye a.
reasons.eligibilityRegional: Ngosipụta ntozu: mmemme lekwasịrị anya mpaghara gụnyere ndị anamachọihe sitere na {{country}}. Kwado mgbe niile ndepụta obodo tozuru etozu na saịtị gọọmentị.
reasons.eligibilityOpen: Mepee mba ụwa - ka gosi na {{country}} dị na ndepụta ntozu okirikiri a tupu itinye oge ngwa.
reasons.officialUrl: Ejikọtara URL gọọmentị - oge ngwụcha na iwu obodo na-agbanwe site na okirikiri.
reasons.remotiveLive: Mbipute na-ebi ndụ sitere na Remotive · {{company}}.
reasons.matchedTerms: Dakọtara {{count}} okwu (s) site na nka / ubi gị megide ederede ọrụ.
reasons.locationRemote: Ọrụ dịpụrụ adịpụ/ụwa niile - enwere ike ịrụ ọrụ site na {{country}} ma ọ bụrụ na onye were gị n'ọrụ na-ahapụ mpaghara gị.
reasons.locationVerify: Nyochaa onye ọrụ na-anabata ndị anamachọihe dabere na {{country}} tupu itinye akwụkwọ.
reasons.remotiveFetched: Ewetara na API Mwepụ Ọhaneze - mepee URL gọọmentị iji gosi na ọ ka dị ndụ.
reasons.skillHits: Akara ndakọrịta nka na nka: {{count}} hits.
reasons.locationListed: Edepụtara na {{location}} - kwado visa/ ntozu ime anya site na {{country}}.
reasons.arbeitnowFetched: Ewetara site na ọha Arbeitnow jobboard API.
reasons.indeedReason: Mba-nzacha n'ezie na-achọ "{{query}}" nso {{country}}. Mepee nsonaazụ ma tinye naanị na ndepụta dabara na nka gị.
reasons.linkedinReason: Ọchụchọ LinkedIn dabere na {{country}} na mpaghara / nka gị dị ka isi okwu.
reasons.remoteReason: Bọọdụ izizi nke dịpụrụ adịpụ nke ejiri nka slug “{{slug}}” wee {{country}} abụghị ihe mgbochi siri ike.
reasons.reliefReason: Nchọ ọrụ ReliefWeb gụnyere {{country}} - bara uru maka mmepe, ahụike na egwu NGO.

tips.sLeadership: Dee akụkọ nduzi nke okwu 150 ga-amalite na {{place}} wee mechie ka onyinye {{source}} na-abawanye mmetụta ahụ.
tips.sModules: Maapụ ndabere {{field}} gị gaa na modul 3 na ebumnuche {{location}} mmemme - kpọọ modulu na nkwupụta nkeonwe gị.
tips.sEssaySkills: N'edemede 1, nyefee otu paragraf ka {{skills}} ewepụtalarị nsonaazụ a tụrụ atụ (ọnụọgụ kụrụ adjectives).
tips.sAdvanced: Na-eduga na omimi {{skill}} gị ({{level}}) dị ka ihe akaebe ị nwere ike ijikwa {{intensity}} ike.
tips.sWeak: Tupu ịnyefe, were obere oru ngo ma ọ bụ asambodo bulie {{skill}} - ndị nyocha na-achọpụta nkwupụta nka emechabeghị.
tips.sRefereeInst: Jụọ onye ọka ikpe sitere na {{institution}} onye hụrụ ka ị na-edu, ọ bụghị naanị na-akụziri gị - ụdị ụdị Chevening na-emetụta oke akara ule naanị.
tips.sRefereeGeneric: Chekwaa ndị ọka ikpe abụọ nwere ike hota otu atụmatụ ị mere - mkpụrụedemede "ụmụ akwụkwọ na-arụsi ọrụ ike" na-edoghị anya profaịlụ siri ike.
tips.sCalendar: Mepụta kalenda azụ azụ site na "{{deadline}}" yana ihe nchekwa maka transcript, ule na ntụnyere aka.
tips.sOffline: Draft na-aza mbụ na-anọghị n'ịntanetị, wee mado na portal - akpaaka-chekwa glitches na-ehichapụ awa ọrụ n'ọtụtụ ụdị agụmakwụkwọ.
tips.sAlumni: Nyocha 2 alumni sitere na {{place}} onye meriri {{source}}; rịba ama ihe ngwa ha mesiri ike wee gosipụta usoro ahụ, ọ bụghị akụkọ ahụ.
tips.sScore: Ọ bụrụ na akara egwuregwu gị bụ {{score}}%, mesoo oghere n'eziokwu na edemede - panels na-akwụghachi mmata onwe onye karịa nkwuputa izu oke.
tips.sHeadline: Hazie isi okwu gị ("{{headline}}") na ebumnuche nke mmemme ahụ ka ihuenyo nke mbụ nwee mmetụta nke ebumnobi.
tips.sPitch: Kwadebe ọkwa ọnụ ọnụ nke abụọ nke abụọ nke atụmatụ ọmụmụ gị maka ajụjụ ọnụ: nsogbu → ọnụ gị → {{source}} dị ka onye na-eme ngwa ngwa.
tips.sProof: Chịkọta ihe akaebe (GitHub, akụkọ, onyinye, akwụkwọ ozi obodo) na-akwado nka ọ bụla ị depụtara - nseta ihuenyo dị njikere tupu itinye akwụkwọ.
tips.sEligibility: Lelee nkeji mba na nlọghachi n'ụlọ maka {{source}} megide ọkwa {{country}} gị usoro okirikiri a - mmejọ ntozu na-efunahụ edemede siri ike.
tips.sBio: Degharịa bio gị ka onye ọbịbịa na {{location}} ghọta ubi gị n'otu ahịrịokwu wee gbasaa.
tips.sCheveningCourses: Họrọ nkuzi UK atọ dabara nke ọma {{field}}, ọ bụghị ugwu naanị - Chevening jụrụ usoro trios na-adaghị adaba ọbụlagodi na edemede siri ike.
tips.sCheveningNet: Wepụta ibe zuru ezu na atụmatụ “netwọk”: nke ọha mmadụ, ụlọ nyocha, ma ọ bụ otu amụma ị ga-esonye, ​​yana ihe ị weghachite na {{place}}.
tips.sDaadFilter: Wepụta DAAD site na ọkwa ogo gị na {{field}}, wee họrọ ndepụta oku 2 - ngwa "Germany" adịkarịghị ekpochapụ nke mbụ.
tips.sDaadLang: Kpebie ngwa ngwa ma ịchọrọ akaebe German ma ọ bụ Bekee maka mmemme nnabata, wee depụta ụbọchị ule tupu oku emechi.
tips.sMastercardApply: Tinye akwụkwọ site na mahadum mmekọ na-akụzi {{field}} - Mastercard Scholars bụ ụlọ akwụkwọ akọwapụtara, ọ bụghị otu ụdị zuru ụwa ọnụ.
tips.sMastercardNeed: Akwụkwọ mkpa na idu ndú ọnụ: otu paragraf na ihe mgbochi, otu na ihe ị gbanwere maka ndị ọzọ na {{place}}.
tips.sFulbrightPage: Jiri naanị peeji Fulbright nke obodo gị - oge imecha na ụdị maka {{country}} dị iche na broshuọ zuru ụwa ọnụ.
tips.sFulbrightObj: Mee ka nyocha / ọmụmụ ihe bụrụ nke a ga-agha ụgha: ajụjụ dị na {{field}} ị ga-aza n'ime ọnwa 12-24?
tips.sGates: Cambridge Fit na-abịa nke mbụ: kpọọ onye nlekọta ma ọ bụ ụlọ nyocha dị mkpa na {{field}} tupu ihichapụ nkwupụta Gates.
tips.sTheme: Kee atụmatụ gị na isiokwu ebipụtara site na {{source}}, na-eji asụsụ sitere na oku - ngbanwe isiokwu bụ ihe a na-ajụ nkịtị.
tips.jResume: Tinyegharịa nchịkọta akụkọ gị ka iji {{skill}} + {{field}} duru, wee kpughee ngwaa 5 kachasị elu site na nke ọ bụla {{source}} biputere ị meghere.
tips.jProof: Jiri mgbọ 3 wuo ibe akwụkwọ nwere ibe 1: nsogbu, ime ihe na-eji {{skills}}, nsonaazụ enwere ike ịtụnye.
tips.jAdvanced: Tinye {{skills}} n'ime ụzọ atọ nke atọ nke LinkedIn/About - ndị na-ewe ndị ọrụ skim, ha anaghị achụ nta.
tips.jWeak: Maka ọrụ chọrọ {{skill}}, tinye obere oru ngo izu ụka wee jikọta ya - nkwupụta etiti na-enweghị ihe akaebe ga-ehichapụ.
tips.jAlerts: Tọọ ọkwa {{source}} maka "{{field}}" na obodo gị ({{country}}), wee tinye n'ime awa 48 nke ikenye.
tips.jTarget: Chebe ụlọ ọrụ 5 kwa izu na-akwụ ụgwọ maka {{field}} na ma ọ bụ site na {{country}}, ọ bụghị 50 random Easy Apply clicks.
tips.jCover: N'ime ndetu mkpuchi ọ bụla, kpọọ otu ihe a ga-ebuga n'ọrụ ị ga-ebufe n'ime ụbọchị 30 mbụ site na iji nchịkọta gị ugbu a.
tips.jReferrals: Rịọ maka ndị na-ezo aka naanị mgbe ị nwere ike ịkọwa ngwaahịa nke otu na ahịrịokwu 2 - oyi na-ajụ na-enweghị ihe omume ụlọ na-agba ọkụ.
tips.jLoom: Dekọọ Loom (ma ọ bụ ndetu olu) 90-sekọnd na-aga site na ọrụ; tinye ya mgbe {{source}} na-enye ohere ozi/tinye mgbakwunye.
tips.jConfidence: Obi ike egwuregwu gị ugbu a bụ ~{{score}}% - ọ bụrụ n'okpuru 70%, mee ka nkà dị ike na Profaịlụ wee maliteghachi tupu ịgbasa ngwa.
tips.jTranslate: Tụgharịa asụsụ agụmakwụkwọ site na {{field}} ka ọ bụrụ asụsụ onye ọrụ: "ọrụ nkuzi" → "ewepụtara X n'okpuru njedebe".
tips.jLog: Debe ndekọ ọjụjụ: ọrụ, nka na-efu, ime ihe ọzọ - ụkpụrụ na-agwa gị ihe ị ga-amụta na-esote ngwa ngwa karịa ịkọ nkọ.
tips.jLinkedinOpen: Tụgharịa Open to Work (naanị ndị na-ewe ndị ọrụ) wee pinye ọrụ egosipụtara nke gosipụtara {{skill}}.
tips.jLinkedinComment: Kwuo echiche nke ọma na ọkwa onye na-ewe ọrụ 3 na {{field}} n'izu a tupu itinye akwụkwọ oyi - visibiliti na-ekpo ọkụ na-akụ jụụ Tinye.
tips.jIndeed: Jiri nzacha ọnọdụ n'ezie dịka "{{country}}" wee hazie site na ụbọchị - reposts stale na-emebi ike.
tips.jRemoteOk: Gụọ ahịrị obodo/mpaghara ugboro abụọ na mpụ OK dị anya - ọtụtụ ọrụ "imetere" ka na-ewepu {{country}}.
tips.jRemoteRate: Ọnụ ọnụ ahịa ndị ọrụ nkwekọrịta gị na mpaghara oge na-agafe n'ihu na ozi mbụ ka ịzenarị ghosting mgbe ihuenyo gasịrị.
tips.jGlassdoor: Gụọ akụkọ ajụjụ ọnụ kacha ọhụrụ maka onye ọrụ ahụ, wee kwadebe akụkọ 2 na-aza usoro ajụjụ ugboro ugboro.
tips.jReliefImpact: Ngwa duo nwere mmetụta ubi/ọrụ afọ ofufo na {{place}} - ReliefWeb na-ewe ahụmịhe dị mkpa metụtara ozi dị arọ.
tips.jReliefLang: Asụsụ dakọtara site na ohere ahụ (Nri, Nchekwa, WASH, wdg) naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike ịgbachitere ya - nri buzzword pụtara ìhè.
tips.jHeadline: Mekọrịta isi okwu ọha gị ka ọ bụrụ “{{headline}}” ebe ọ bụla ị na-etinye ya mere {{source}} enyo ma CV gị kọọ otu akụkọ.
